jobDetail.jobDescription:
■ ABOUT CARDIOBIRD 

CardioBird is revolutionizing animal healthcare as the world’s leading veterinary biosignal analytics platform, serving 1,000+ clinics globally. We combine cutting-edge AI technology with veterinary expertise to deliver fast, accurate cardiac diagnostics and monitoring for animals. Join our mission-driven team to build products that create a healthier tomorrow for pets and their families. 

■ THE ROLE 

We are seeking a UI/UX & QA Specialist who combines design excellence with quality ownership. This is a creative hybrid position that elevates the designer into a gatekeeper of product experience and quality, and transforms QA from passively finding bugs into actively ensuring that the final product fulfills its design intent.
You will work closely with our engineers and product owners to craft and validate intuitive, high-quality mobile and web interfaces. Your attention to detail and user-centric mindset will ensure every release not only functions smoothly but also feels beautifully designed.

■ RESPONSIBILITIES

Design intuitive and visually refined user interfaces across mobile and web applications.

Conduct rigorous design reviews and UIUX quality testing to ensure all builds align precisely with design specifications.

Create, document, and maintain design standards and quality checklists for consistent user experience.

Collaborate with product owners, managers and engineers to communicate design intent and resolve UX gaps during development.

Perform manual usability testing and report feedback on interaction flows, accessibility, and visual quality.

Proactively identify UI/UX inconsistencies, usability issues, and improvement opportunities before release.

Contribute to evolving the product’s overall visual identity and interaction language.

Other duties assigned by supervisors.

■ WHY JOIN US? (RIGHTS & CULTURE)

Competitive salary benchmarked to the local market. 

Flexibility to work remotely from a safe, healthy location of your choice. 

10 days of annual leave (accrued pro-rata). 

[ Growth & Impact ]

Flat hierarchy: Own projects and make an impact from Day 1. 

Training in product development, veterinary medicine, and AI technology. 

Build products that transform animal healthcare globally. 

Thrive in a fun, idea-driven virtual space where creativity is celebrated.
